description: (Pomona, CA)- Michelle Rodriguez, candidate for California's 53rd Assembly District, announced today an endorsement from the California Statewide Law Enforcement Association (CSLEA). This significant endorsement underscores Michelle’s unwavering commitment to public safety and her resolve to build stronger relationships between law enforcement agencies and the communities they serve. View press release
